theorems.name: password_never_served
theorems.doc: (S) A password is never served: the marker always replaces it.
theorems.proof:
theorem password_never_served : serve_password = ok true := by
  simp [serve_password]

theorems.name: keep_marker
theorems.doc: (S) The marker keeps the stored password; anything else replaces it.
theorems.statement: theorem keep_marker (b : Bool) : password b = ok (if b then Password.KeepStored else Password.Replace)
theorems.proof:
theorem keep_marker (b : Bool) : password b = ok (if b then Password.KeepStored else Password.Replace) := by
  cases b <;> simp [password]

theorems.name: zero_samples_refused
theorems.doc: (S) An STPM config that averages no sample is refused (upstream takes it, and the calibration then divides by zero).
theorems.proof:
theorem zero_samples_refused : stpm_ok 0#u32 = ok false := by
  simp [stpm_ok]

theorems.name: no_division_by_zero_samples
theorems.doc: (S) No sample with zero readings is calibrated.
theorems.statement: theorem no_division_by_zero_samples (n : Std.U32) (h : publish_ok n = ok true) : 0 < n.val
theorems.proof:
theorem no_division_by_zero_samples (n : Std.U32) (h : publish_ok n = ok true) : 0 < n.val := by
  unfold publish_ok at h
  simp at h
  scalar_tac

theorems.name: no_division_by_zero_period
theorems.doc: (S) The frequency is computed only from a measured period.
theorems.statement: theorem no_division_by_zero_period (t : Std.U32) (h : frequency_ok t = ok true) : t.val ≠ 0
theorems.proof:
theorem no_division_by_zero_period (t : Std.U32) (h : frequency_ok t = ok true) : t.val ≠ 0 := by
  unfold frequency_ok at h
  simp at h
  scalar_tac

frequency_ok.lean:
def frequency_ok (tdiff : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  ok (tdiff != 0#u32)

password.lean:
def password (is_keep_marker : Bool) : Result Password := do
  if is_keep_marker
  then ok Password.KeepStored
  else ok Password.Replace

Password.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Password where
| KeepStored : Password
| Replace : Password

publish_ok.lean:
def publish_ok (num_samples : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  ok (num_samples >= 1#u32)

stpm_ok.lean:
def stpm_ok (samples : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  ok (samples >= 1#u32)

serve_password.lean:
def serve_password : Result Bool := do
  ok true
